summary: Tested the Switcho integration end to end. Backend: 11 pytest tests now pass (incolla, messages from unknown clients with manual abbina, list, change categoria, chiudi, avvisa-cliente, rispondi with no group configured, config GET/PUT plus 403 for non-admin, snippet, webhook inbox with 401/ok/dedup/wrong sender, attachment tipo). Jev AI classification is really in use (ai=true, confidence 1.0), not the rules fallback. One bug found and fixed: the attachment 'tipo' was checked but never saved. Frontend: in the switcho-box, incolla, the cards, the categoria select, the abbina dialog with search and pick, Fatto and the config dialog with save all work. The attachment-tipo-select in the client card is MISSING from the frontend. All test data was removed.

minor.issue: Form field 'tipo' was validated (bad value -> 400) but never saved in the attachment doc, so the response and DB had no tipo. FIXED by the testing agent: added "tipo": tipo to the doc in server.py upload_attachment.

ui_bugs.issue: No 'tipo' select (bolletta/documento/altro) exists. data-testid attachment-tipo-select is not in the codebase, and uploadAttachment only sends 'file' in the FormData, never 'tipo'. The attachments list also does not show the tipo.

issues: The 'Rispondi a Switcho' button shows even when gruppo_jid is not set, so it always ends in a 400 toast. Consider disabling it or adding a hint.

action_items: Add attachment-tipo-select (bolletta/documento/altro) to ClientDetail attachments-card. Append fd.append('tipo', tipo) in uploadAttachment and show a tipo badge in the list.
Optional: hide or disable 'Rispondi a Switcho' while no gruppo_jid is configured.
critical_code_review_comments: switcho._clienti_candidati loads every energy client from the last 400 days for every message (full scan plus Python matching). Fine for now, but it will get slow. Consider a cognome index or caching per incolla batch.
incolla parses '[hh:mm, dd/mm/yyyy]' into a naive local timestamp, while other 'at' values are UTC-aware ISO. Sorting by the 'at' string mixes the two formats, so the order can be slightly off.
Webhook secret is compared with '!='. Use hmac.compare_digest.
_classifica_regole: 'confermare' in t or 'conferma' in t and (...) relies on operator precedence. Add parentheses for clarity.
Name matching needs the whole cognome plus the first nome. Namesakes produce several segnalazioni and actions (WhatsApp) for each match, with no ambiguity flag.
No indexes on switcho_segnalazioni(id, stato, at) or switcho_messaggi(id).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all Switcho UI flows OK; attachment-tipo-select missing)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST clients Testa Bolletta, Testb Link and TESTc Interfaccia (Morbegno). Removed all of them along with the 4 previous test clients (Lino, Lentini, Melazzi, Ciappa) and all switcho_segnalazioni, switcho_messaggi, wa_log, lavorazioni_log and attachments linked to them. The settings doc switcho_cfg now exists with default values (saved from the UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_iter37_switcho.py -n 0 (it needs serial order because of shared STATE). Afterwards run python tests/cleanup_iter37.py to remove the data. The conferma_link WhatsApp has a 20h dedup per client. When gruppo_jid is empty, the webhook accepts any group. Remaining item: the frontend attachment-tipo-select.
